inputs.description: Inputs into the workflow that is being optimized

rules.description:
Rules that define how vertices within a {@link Workflow} are handled for CSE. Note that if multiple rules apply to
a vertex, only the first rule will be applied.

title:
The {@link Workflow.Cse} optimization, known as Common Subexpression Elimination (CSE), replaces common subgraphs to
avoid repeating computation. The algorithm checks whether two vertices are "equivalent", and if so, removes the
redundant {@link Workflow.Vertex}.

By default, two vertices are considered equivalent if they represent the same computation and all inputs are
equivalent. Custom equivalence checks can be implemented through {@link Workflow.Cse.Rule.VertexRule}s.
name: Workflow.Cse
